::: {.hero}
# Malaria Policy Repository

::: {.lede}
A continuously updated, country-level reference for malaria case management policies — starting with *Plasmodium vivax* malaria with the potential for expansion going forward. Find information on *P. vivax* treatment regimens, G6PD testing recommendations, implementation status, and connect with malaria programmes. Built for national malaria control programmes (NMCPs), researchers, and partners working toward elimination.
:::

## Why this exists

National treatment guidelines are often published — but they are scattered, inconsistently versioned, and rarely available in a comparable form. A previous review was published in *Pathogens* in 2023. This repository is a living continuation of that effort, designed to stay current and to make every data point comparable across countries.

The tools available to test for and treat *P. vivax* malaria have changed rapidly in the last few years. Point-of-care G6PD tests, shorter and more effective radical cure regimens (single-dose tafenoquine, high-dose 7-day primaquine), and updated WHO global recommendations in 2022, 2023, and 2024 have triggered policy revisions across endemic countries.

The repository offers access to key *P. vivax* case management policy and implementation information for national policymakers, researchers, and other partners to help inform decision-making, foster collaboration and networking, and guide research planning and design.

::: {.callout-edit}
This repository is developed in consultation with NMCPs and partners. In its initial phase the repository is only accessible to NMCPs. In its next phase, NMCPs will be able to flag specific data points as visible only to other programmes and partners; the public site will show what countries have agreed to share publicly or what is already publicly available.
:::

## How it works

The information displayed on this website is sourced from approved data in a Google Sheet maintained by the repository team. Partners can submit proposed changes through the [contribute form](contribute.qmd); the repository team reviews them before approved information is transferred into the production data. When the site rebuilds (manually or on a schedule), the latest approved data is pulled and rendered. See [Methods](methods.qmd) for details.

## Cite this repository

If you use these data in a publication or report, please cite:

> Malaria Policy Repository. Updated `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")`. Available at: https://menzies-malaria.github.io/vivax-repo/.

And the foundational review:

> Sadhewa A, Cassidy-Seyoum S, Acharya S, Devine A, Price RN, Mwaura M, et al. A Review of the Current Status of G6PD Deficiency Testing to Guide Radical Cure Treatment for Vivax Malaria. *Pathogens*. 2023;12(5):650.
